role.roleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation

evidence.text: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of project management and phased hand‑over

evidence.text: Briefed the warehouse shift teams before each phase under the change briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the shift leads; fourteen phase briefings across the two warehouses.

Managed the automation contractor under the works contract on both projects, with the contract records holding the site instructions and the twelve defect notices I issued with the contractor's responses.
Prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs; the acceptance was the warehouse manager's, recorded on each pack together with which checks were mine and which the warehouse's.
evidence.notes: Acceptance pack preparation and responsibility boundaries

evidence.text: Wrote the closure report for each warehouse with the project boundary statement and the acceptance test evidence signed by the automation contractor and the warehouse manager.
